question: What was the Revised Estimate (RE) for the Department of Rural Development for the financial year 2024-25, as per the Annual Report 2024-25, published by Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India?
solution:
The Correct answer is __**₹173,912.11 crore**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Department of Rural Development** is a key department under the **Ministry of Rural Development, Government of India**, responsible for implementing various schemes aimed at rural development.
 
• The **Revised Estimate (RE)** for the financial year 2024-25 was reported to be **₹173,912.11 crore**, as per the Annual Report published by the Ministry.
 
• This allocation is targeted towards enhancing the living standards in rural areas, focusing on **poverty alleviation, infrastructure development, and social welfare schemes**.
 
• Key programs under the Department include the **Mahatma Gandhi National Rural Employment Guarantee Act (MGNREGA)**, **National Rural Livelihood Mission (NRLM)**, and **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana-Gramin (PMAY-G)**.
 
• The Revised Estimate ensures adjustments in the budget based on actual requirements and priorities, ensuring effective resource utilization.
 
• Such funding is crucial for achieving **Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs)**, especially those related to **poverty reduction, decent work, and economic growth** in rural India.
